environment.description: Celery worker running in ECS Fargate task in a private subnet with NAT gateway providing internet egress. CloudWatch Logs agent forwards /var/log/celery/worker.log to a log group consumed by a SIEM with automated alerting rules that parse log lines. Worker task role has ssm:SendCommand and logs:PutLogEvents permissions.

config.network: private subnet with NAT gateway (10.0.128.0/24, route 0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-0a1b2c3d4e5f)
